data.name: Hamam: The Steaming Backrooms
data.detailed_description:
🎭 A Ritual Hidden in Steam

HAMAM: The Steaming Backrooms is a first-person psychological horror game set inside a mysterious Turkish bathhouse where reality slowly begins to collapse.

You wake up inside a silent, abandoned hamam with no clear way out. The marble walls echo with distant sounds, steam fills the corridors, and something watches you from the dark.

To escape, you must complete a ritual by finding ancient seals, placing them into the correct sockets, and uncovering the truth hidden behind the bathhouse.

But every step brings you closer to her.

📸 The Camera Sees What You Cannot

Your photo camera is more than a tool. It reveals hidden changes, reacts to cursed objects, and becomes your only defense against the entity that appears during the ritual.

Take photos carefully. Some things should not be seen.

🎵 Music Box Encounters

The ritual is tied to cursed music boxes scattered throughout the hamam. Holding the music box keeps the ritual alive, but the longer it plays, the closer she gets.

If she reaches you, there is no escape.

🧩 Ritual-Based Progression

Explore the bathhouse, collect ritual seals, unlock new areas, and solve environmental puzzles. Each completed step changes the atmosphere around you and brings the nightmare closer to its final form.

👁️ A Presence in the Bathhouse

She does not simply chase you.

She appears when the ritual calls her.

She listens.

She watches.

And when the music begins, she comes closer.

🎧 Immersive Horror Atmosphere

Experience a dense and unsettling atmosphere built with realistic lighting, baked reflections, steam, echoing footsteps, distant whispers, and minimal interface design.

The hamam is not just a location.

It is part of the nightmare.

⭐ Full Version

This full release expands the original Early Access version with a more complete ritual structure, improved atmosphere, new interactions, polished menus, localized text, music box encounters, a final sequence, and a more focused horror experience.

Can you complete the ritual before the steam consumes you?

data.short_description: Step into HAMAM, a Backrooms-inspired psychological horror set in a cursed Turkish bathhouse. Find ritual seals, use your camera to reveal hidden horrors, survive cursed music boxes, and escape the presence waiting in the steam.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 4GB / AMD RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p Low/Medium settings. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 1080p High settings with stable performance. SSD recommended.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent scenes of violence, blood, and disturbing imagery. 
It includes dark and oppressive environments, supernatural horror elements, 
and terrifying situations that may not be suitable for all players. 
There is no sexual content, but the atmosphere can be very intense and frightening.
